description: How countries and territories in Asia and the Middle East define, label and sell non-alcoholic beer: the alcohol level at which a drink counts as alcoholic, the terms a label may use, the main sale rules, and a link to the law, regulator or official standard behind each fact. Also what official halal bodies have published. General information, not legal advice. Pass a country to get one row; leave it out to get every row. SOMA itself delivers in India only.

country.description: A country or territory, e.g. 'Japan', 'UAE', 'Dubai', 'Saudi Arabia', 'Korea'. Leave out for all rows.

name: get_na_beer_rules
title: Non-alcoholic beer rules by country
